Telephone Manager Initialization Functions / Working With a Telephone Tool

TELGetToolName

Returns the name of the telephone tool associated with a tool ID. 
pascal void TELGetToolName (short procID, Str255 name);
procID
The tool ID dynamically assigned to the telephone tool through the TELGetProcID function.
name
On exit, a Pascal-style string that contains the name of the specified telephone tool.
DESCRIPTION
The TELGetToolName function returns, in the name parameter, the name of the telephone tool having the ID specified by the procID parameter. A zero-length string is returned in place of the tool name if the specified tool ID can not be reconciled for any existing telephone records.
